title: When the Debt Wakes
author: Ulyana Zhou
blurb: Emrys Reyes, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
